name: TeamStarWolf - Hugging Face AI Supply Chain (ATLAS)
description: ATLAS 2026.10 techniques that MITRE maps in the five Hugging Face case studies (AML.CS0019, AML.CS0027, AML.CS0031, AML.CS0065, AML.CS0068) plus the adjacent LAMEHUG step, as bound in the Hugging Face case study. Comments carry the study's source numbers. Scores indicate membership only.

legendItems.label: 100: mapped by ATLAS 2026.10 in a Hugging Face case study (membership, not severity)

metadata.name: score_meaning
metadata.value: 100 means ATLAS lists the technique in a procedure step of one of the cited case studies; no severity, prevalence or coverage is measured.

links.label: Hugging Face as an AI Supply-Chain Attack Surface: A 2021 to 2026 Case Study

techniques.comment: PoisonGPT AML.CS0019 (July 2023): GPT-J-6B pulled from the Hub as the base model. Sources: [65] ATLAS 2026.10; [67] Mithril Security, 2023-07-09.
PoisonGPT AML.CS0019 (ROME edit of GPT-J-6B, July 2023) and Organization Confusion AML.CS0027 (2023-08-23). Sources: [65]; [67]; [68].
PoisonGPT AML.CS0019 (July 2023). Source: [65].
Poisoned or malicious models published to the Hub: AML.CS0019 (2023-07), AML.CS0027 (2023-08-23), AML.CS0031 (2025), AML.CS0065 (2025-09-03). Sources: [65]; [67]; [30]; [34].
Model repository as the delivery path: AML.CS0019, AML.CS0027, AML.CS0065; also the ShadowRay step AML.CS0023 S05. Sources: [65]; [34]; [67].
Malicious Models on Hugging Face AML.CS0031 (ReversingLabs nullifAI, published 2025-02-06) maps the parent technique. Sources: [65]; [30].
Victim loads an unsafe model artifact: AML.CS0027, AML.CS0031, AML.CS0065. Sources: [65]; [27]; [30]; [34].
Malware embedded in model files: Keras Lambda layer (AML.CS0027), pickle payloads (AML.CS0031), reverse-shell models (AML.CS0065). Sources: [65]; [68]; [30]; [34].
AML.CS0031: models that cannot be fully deserialized evaded Picklescan (2025). Sources: [65]; [30].
Reverse shells and implants from loaded models: AML.CS0027 (Sliver), AML.CS0031 (107.173.7.141), AML.CS0065. Sources: [65]; [30]; [34]; [68].
Attacker accounts and organizations on the Hub: AML.CS0027 (2023), AML.CS0065 (reclaimed author namespace, 2025). Sources: [65]; [34]; [68].
AML.CS0027 organization confusion (2023-08-23). Sources: [65]; [68].
AML.CS0027 (implant named training.bin) and AML.CS0065 (recreated namespace). Sources: [65]; [68]; [34].
